# Geographically Weighted Predictive Models

## 1. Installing and Loading R packages



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, spdep, GWmodel, SpatialML, 
               tmap, rsample, Metrics, tidyverse)
```
:::



## 2. Preparing Data

### 2.1 Reading data file to rds



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mdata <- read_rds("data/rawdata/mdata.rds")
```
:::



### 2.2 Data Sampling



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
resale_split <- initial_split(mdata, 
                              prop = 6.5/10,)
train_data <- training(resale_split)
test_data <- testing(resale_split)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_rds(train_data, "data/model/train_data.rds")
write_rds(test_data, "data/model/test_data.rds")
```
:::



## 3. Computing Correlation Matrix



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mdata_nogeo <- mdata %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
corrplot::corrplot(cor(mdata_nogeo[, 2:17]), 
                   diag = FALSE, 
                   order = "AOE",
                   tl.pos = "td", 
                   tl.cex = 0.5, 
                   method = "number", 
                   type = "upper")
```
:::



## 4. Retriving the Stored Data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
train_data <- read_rds("data/model/train_data.rds")
test_data <- read_rds("data/model/test_data.rds")
```
:::



## 5. Building a non-spatial multiple linear regression



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
price_mlr <- lm(resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
                  storey_order + remaining_lease_mths +
                  PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + PROX_HAWKER +
                  PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + PROX_MALL + 
                  PROX_SUPERMARKET + WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN +
                  WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + WITHIN_350M_BUS +
                  WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
                data=train_data)
summary(price_mlr)
```

## 6. gwr predictive method

### 6.1 Computing adaptive bandwidth



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_adaptive <- bw.gwr(
  formula = resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
    storey_order + remaining_lease_mths +
    PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + PROX_HAWKER +
    PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + PROX_MALL + 
    PROX_SUPERMARKET + WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN +
    WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + WITHIN_350M_BUS +
    WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
  data=train_data,
  approach="CV",
  kernel="gaussian",
  adaptive=TRUE,
  longlat=FALSE)

write_rds(bw_adaptive, "data/model/bw_adaptive.rds")
```
:::



### 6.2 Constructing the adaptive bandwidth gwr model



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw_adaptive <- read_rds(
  "data/model/bw_adaptive.rds") 
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwr_adaptive <- gwr.basic(
  formula = resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
    storey_order + remaining_lease_mths + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + 
    PROX_HAWKER + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + 
    PROX_MALL + PROX_SUPERMARKET +
    WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN +
    WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + 
    WITHIN_350M_BUS + WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
  data=train_data,
  bw=bw_adaptive, 
  kernel = 'gaussian', 
  adaptive=TRUE,
  longlat = FALSE)

write_rds(gwr_adaptive, 
          "data/model/gwr_adaptive.rds")
```
:::



### 6.3 Retrieve gwr output object



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwr_adaptive <- read_rds("data/model/gwr_adaptive.rds")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwr_adaptive
```
:::



### 6.4 Computing adaptive bandwidth for the test data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwr_bw_test_adaptive <- bw.gwr(
  formula = resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
    storey_order + remaining_lease_mths +
    PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + PROX_HAWKER +
    PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + PROX_MALL + 
    PROX_SUPERMARKET + WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN +
    WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + WITHIN_350M_BUS +
    WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
  data=test_data,
  approach="CV",
  kernel="gaussian",
  adaptive=TRUE,
  longlat=FALSE)

write_rds(gwr_bw_test_adaptive, 
          "data/model/gwr_bw_test_adaptive.rds")
```
:::



## 7. Calibrating Random Forest Model

### 7.1 Preparing coordinates data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
coords <- st_coordinates(mdata)
coords_train <- st_coordinates(train_data)
coords_test <- st_coordinates(test_data)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
coords_train <- write_rds(
  coords_train, 
  "data/model/coords_train.rds" )
coords_test <- write_rds(
  coords_test, 
  "data/model/coords_test.rds" )
```
:::



### 7.2 Droping geometry field



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
train_data_nogeom <- train_data %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

test_data_nogeom <- test_data %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
```
:::



### 7.3 Calibrating a non-spatial random forest model



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
rf <- ranger(
  formula = resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
    storey_order + remaining_lease_mths + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + 
    PROX_HAWKER + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + 
    PROX_MALL + PROX_SUPERMARKET +
    WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN + 
    WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + 
    WITHIN_350M_BUS +  
    WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
  data=train_data_nogeom)
rf
```

## 8. Calibrating Geographical Weighted Random Forest Model

### 8.1 Calibrating using training data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
gwRF_adaptive <- grf(
  formula = resale_price ~ floor_area_sqm +
    storey_order + remaining_lease_mths + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_ELDERLYCARE + 
    PROX_HAWKER + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + 
    PROX_MALL + PROX_SUPERMARKET +
    WITHIN_350M_KINDERGARTEN +
    WITHIN_350M_CHILDCARE + 
    WITHIN_350M_BUS + WITHIN_1KM_PRISCH,
  dframe=train_data_nogeom, 
  bw=40,
  kernel="adaptive",
  coords=coords_train)

write_rds(gwRF_adaptive, "data/model/gwRF_adaptive.rds")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwRF_adaptive <- read_rds("data/model/gwRF_adaptive.rds")
```
:::
